title: Upādānam
text: 1-2 Sāvatthi || || Upādāniye ce bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi upādānaṃ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || 4 Katame ca bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā || katamam upādānaṃ || || 5 Rūpam bhikkhave upādāniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ || || 6-8 Vedanā || pa || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || || 9 Viññāṇam upādāniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānaṃ || || 10 Ime vuccanti bhikkhave upādāniyā dhammā || idam upādānan ti || ||
